analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 41.1 to 52.0, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -2.1568 to 0.3657, signaling bottoming. The 5-day high ($351.79) is higher than the 5-day low ($320.23), forming a Higher Low pattern. ADX at 24.2 indicates the early stage of trend formation. Volume at 0.65 of the 5-day average is subdued, requiring caution for directional confirmation. Current price $350.45 is near the swing support of $350.06.
